schema_note: Daily QA run conforming to qa/findings.schema.json. Produced by scheduled task nakshiq-daily-test on 2026-04-29.

run.executor: Claude (Cowork scheduled task) — single Chrome session + curl HTTP probes

environment.measurement_method: curl --max-time time_total for HTTP timings; performance.getEntriesByType('navigation') in Chrome for browser-side metrics; x-vercel-cache header inspection (HIT/PRERENDER/MISS) for caching state. Warm-CDN times measured for the 12-destination panel; cold-render times sampled from MISS/PRERENDER paths (month sub-routes + 8 destinations not in the warm panel).

coverage.selection_rationale: Same 12-destination panel as 2026-04-26/27/28 to keep day-over-day deltas honest. Spiti retained as the soft-404 canary (llms.txt references but no canonical destination row). 8 additional cold-render slugs (goa, rishikesh, agra, jodhpur, mussoorie, ranthambore, lonavala, mahabaleshwar) sampled solely for performance signal — not parsed for content.

coverage.locale_coverage: Both /en/ and /hi/ probed for all 12 destinations + 7 key navigation pages + 4 collection slugs.

performance.method: Two-pass HTTP probing: (1) 12-destination panel curled with all paths returning x-vercel-cache: HIT (CDN-warm, all 24 fetches); (2) 8 cold-render destinations (goa, rishikesh, agra, jodhpur, mussoorie, ranthambore, lonavala, mahabaleshwar) sampled to surface true SSR+TTFB times — these returned x-vercel-cache: MISS or PRERENDER. Browser-side performance.getEntriesByType('navigation') captured on /en/destination/jaipur and /en/destination/manali reloads.
performance.ttfb_unavailable_reason: curl time_total used as proxy for total page load on HTTP probes; per-phase TTFB measured only via browser navigation entry on jaipur/manali reloads.

samples.note: Soft-reload likely served from BFCache + CDN; fast.

browser_metrics.notes: Browser-side TTFB consistently <90ms for warm-CDN destination pages; the cold-render p95 (~4.6s) is a server-side SSR signal, not a real-user-experience metric for the panel destinations.

regression_matrix.title: Invisible content rendering on all destination detail pages
regression_matrix.evidence: All 11 real destinations rendered visible content with 24-38 H2s, 26-61 H3s, 3-14 H4s, 6-7 JSON-LD blocks each, 6-15 'confidence' mentions. No invisible-content artifacts in /en or /hi.

regression_matrix.title: Only 1 of 20 collections rendering
regression_matrix.evidence: /en/collections lists 91 collection links; /hi/collections also 91. Sample of 4 real slugs (best-beaches-india, adrenaline-rush, after-dark-experiences, ancient-monasteries) all return 200 in both locales with proper bodies.

regression_matrix.title: 503 Service Unavailable on RSC prefetch
regression_matrix.evidence: RSC: 1 header on /en/destination/jaipur returns 200 with content-type text/x-component, x-vercel-cache: PRERENDER. RSC sampled across 8 destinations — all 200. No 503s.

regression_matrix.title: Empty modal flash between wizard steps
regression_matrix.evidence: /en/plan is a single-page AI matcher (43 buttons, 1 input, 0 modals, 0 forms, 0 'data-step' wizard markers). Multi-step wizard surface area is gone, so the flash defect cannot recur.

regression_matrix.title: Hindi translation only partially applied
regression_matrix.evidence: Destination titles localize the city name to Devanagari (e.g. जयपुर) but state name and the suffix 'Best Time to Visit & Weather | NakshIQ' remain English on every /hi destination. Hindi collection page titles (4/4 sampled) are entirely English. Confidence-token count drops by exactly 2 on every /hi vs /en pair (8 destinations sampled). Same partial-translation surface as 2026-04-27/28.

regression_matrix.title: Duration field shows '- days' (missing data)
regression_matrix.evidence: No '- days' string in any sampled destination HTML; itinerary endpoint returns structured 4xx errors (not malformed days field).

regression_matrix.title: Map markers vs results count mismatch
regression_matrix.evidence: On /en/destination/jaipur the page body claims '20 Places' but document.querySelectorAll('.leaflet-marker-icon').length === 0 after 8s. Same on /en/destination/leh ('20' vs 0) and /en/destination/manali ('23' vs 0). Leaflet container, panes (7), and basemap tiles all render — only the marker pane is empty. Fourth consecutive day of reproduction.

regression_matrix.title: Duplicate 'NakshIQ' in destination page titles
regression_matrix.evidence: All 24 sampled destination titles contain exactly one 'NakshIQ' token.

regression_matrix.title: Treks page title contradicts body content count
regression_matrix.evidence: /en/treks 200, 1.16MB body, no obvious title-vs-count contradiction. Heuristic curl + grep didn't expose a mismatch and no regression evidence collected since 2026-04-25.

regression_matrix.title: Filter bar disappears after Clear Filters
regression_matrix.evidence: On /en/explore: clicked '👶 Kids Friendly' chip (button count 122→123, Clear Filters appeared), then clicked 'Clear Filters ✕' (back to 121, Clear Filters removed because no filters active, Kids Friendly chip and full filter bar still visible). No collapse.

regression_matrix.title: 930 network requests on single page load
regression_matrix.evidence: Fresh load of /en/destination/jaipur issued 57 network requests (29 first-party JS/CSS chunks, 14 basemap tiles, 4 fonts, 2 API calls, plus analytics + cdnjs leaflet CSS). Far below the 930 observed on 2026-04-22.

regression_matrix.title: Multiple GoTrueClient instances warning (Supabase)
regression_matrix.evidence: Console captured during /en/destination/manali reload contained 15 messages — all from a chrome-extension URL prefix (cfeleongjhdjephegmmmdjgbfjiindbe). Zero GoTrueClient/Multiple/Supabase warnings.

regression_matrix.title: Heading hierarchy skips H2 entirely
regression_matrix.evidence: All 11 real destinations have 24-38 H2s; H2 hierarchy intact. Spiti soft-404 has 0 H2s but that is a separate defect (see BUG-007 cluster and NEW-2026-04-29-001).

regression_matrix.title: Card images slow to load (lazy loading too aggressive)
regression_matrix.evidence: On /en/destination/jaipur counted 31 : 15 loading=lazy, 0 loading=eager, 16 with no loading attribute. Lazy:eager ratio still skewed lazy and identical to 2026-04-28. Cannot programmatically measure perceived speed without LCP samples; flagged as partial-unverifiable to track the underlying ratio without claiming a UX regression.

new_defects.title: /sitemap.xml top-level STILL 500 — 3rd consecutive day, no fix shipped
new_defects.evidence: GET https://www.nakshiq.com/sitemap.xml returned HTTP 500 in 2.155s with a 10,560-byte body. Same status as 2026-04-28. Originally regressed 2026-04-27→2026-04-28 (404→500) on deploy dpl_2kWq8YPoJqc2RH6EFa16NMPRz4Xc; today's deploy dpl_4r9aWUNY7uNLZLx35XEV1Dkpo3E5 did not address it.
new_defects.impact: SEO crawlers that probe /sitemap.xml first (default behavior for many bots) will hit a 500 instead of a clean 404 + robots.txt redirect. Google Search Console may degrade index coverage signals.

new_defects.title: hreflang link tags STILL absent site-wide (4th consecutive day)
new_defects.evidence: Counted 0 <link rel="alternate" hreflang> tags on /en/destination/jaipur, /hi/destination/jaipur, /en/destination/leh, /en/collections, /en, /hi. First flagged 2026-04-26 as NEW-001, repeated 2026-04-27 NEW-005 and 2026-04-28 NEW-2026-04-28-002. No fix shipped.
new_defects.impact: Bilingual SEO is leaving Hindi-page indexability on the table — Google has no signal that /en/destination/jaipur and /hi/destination/jaipur are alternates, so it may de-duplicate them.

new_defects.title: Soft-404 on /destination/<bad-slug> persists in BOTH locales (4th consecutive day in this scope)
new_defects.evidence: /en/destination/this-does-not-exist-xyz → 200, 73,623 bytes; /hi/destination/this-does-not-exist-xyz → 200, 84,341 bytes. Both serve homepage shell. /en/collections/<bad>, /en/region/<bad> correctly return 404. Soft-404 is still isolated to the destination route group.
new_defects.impact: Crawlers can index unbounded fake URLs; analytics gets dirtied.
new_defects.recommended_owner: web (apps/web/src/app/[locale]/destination/[slug]/page.tsx — call notFound() on missing row)

new_defects.title: Numeric month sub-routes /destination/<slug>/<1-12> still soft-404 (llms.txt contract violation)
new_defects.evidence: Probed /en/destination/jaipur/3, /5, /10 and /en/destination/shimla/3, /5, /10 — all returned 200 with 73,911-73,913 bytes (homepage shell). The named variants (/march, /may, /october) return 148-176KB real pages. llms.txt promises numeric month routes; they are not honored. Carryover of NEW-2026-04-28-004.
new_defects.impact: AI crawlers following llms.txt advice get indexed onto homepage HTML for what they think are month-specific destination pages — bad for citation quality and llms.txt audits.

new_defects.title: /en/region/<state> 404s for tamil-nadu AND kerala (no fix shipped in 24h)
new_defects.evidence: Probed 7 region landing pages. 200: rajasthan, karnataka, maharashtra, ladakh, himachal-pradesh. 404: tamil-nadu (carryover from 2026-04-27 NEW-003, 2026-04-28 NEW-005), kerala (carryover from 2026-04-28 NEW-005). Both states have many destinations in the sitemap — the region landing simply doesn't exist.
new_defects.impact: Two large source-of-traffic states have no region-level landing page; users navigating from sitemap or external links land on a 404.

new_defects.title: /en/cost-index payload still 3.61 MB (no shrink in 72h)
new_defects.evidence: GET /en/cost-index returned 200 in 2.223s with 3,613,315 bytes. Within ~700 bytes of 2026-04-28 (3,612,641 bytes); essentially identical. No shrink shipped.
new_defects.impact: Slow load on mobile connections; ~15s on a 2 Mbps link. Likely contains a large embedded data payload that should be paginated or fetched async.

new_defects.title: Confidence mention count drops EXACTLY 2 in /hi vs /en across 8 destinations (proxy for partial-Hindi)
new_defects.evidence: Per-page count of literal token 'confidence' in HTML, en→hi: jaipur 11→9, shimla 12→10, manali 15→13, leh 13→11, varanasi 11→9, udaipur 9→7, darjeeling 9→7, kaza 8→6. Delta is consistently 2 — strongly suggests two specific 'confidence' UI strings are still English-only on /en pages while their /hi counterparts are localized to a different word (or absent). Quantifies the partial-Hindi gap under BUG-005.
new_defects.impact: Adds a deterministic data point under BUG-005 — the gap is a fixed two-string bug, not a rolling content drift.
new_defects.reproduction: for s in jaipur shimla manali leh varanasi udaipur darjeeling kaza; do echo $s; for l in en hi; do curl -s https://www.nakshiq.com/$l/destination/$s | grep -oiE confidence | wc -l; done; done

gaps: 12-destination panel returned x-vercel-cache: HIT for every request — today's run could not isolate cold SSR times for the panel. Cold-render performance was instead sampled via 8 non-panel destinations (ranthambore was the slowest at 4.65s, well under the 8s threshold) and via month sub-routes that returned x-vercel-cache: MISS (jaipur/march cold render 3.47s).

Live console message capture is partial — Chrome MCP starts tracking only after the first read_console_messages call; messages emitted during the initial page load are not retrievable. BUG-012 verdict relies on a navigation-then-reload pattern; only a soft-reload sample was captured, with all 15 messages traced to a chrome-extension origin.

Browser-side performance metrics sampled on 2 page loads only (jaipur initial nav + manali reload); primary perf signal remains curl time_total, which conflates DNS+TLS+TTFB+download. Real-user TTFB / LCP / INP would require a full Web Vitals run.
